senses.gloss: f. (סָנַן) [the glistening,] swallow. Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 3, ch. V הס׳; Ḥull. 62ᵃ ס׳ לבנה the white-bellied swallow.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:23">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:23">IV</cite>), 23 <he>אוכלין את ס׳ לבנה וכ׳</he> used to eat the white-bellied swallow, because &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:7">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>אימת ס׳ על הנשר</he> the fear which the eagle has of the swallow; a. e.
